description: This file defines a React hook 'useCart' for managing shopping cart state, supporting both backend and local cart modes, with functions for adding, removing, updating items, and synchronizing cart data with an API.

methods.name: toCartViewFromBackend
methods.description: Converts a backend cart response into a CartView object.

methods.name: toCartViewFromLocal
methods.description: Creates a CartView object from local cart data.

methods.name: mergeSkusIntoBackendCart
methods.description: Merges SKU hints from local cart into a backend CartView for UI display.

methods.name: useCart
methods.description: React hook managing cart state, supporting backend and local modes, with functions to manipulate cart items.
